title: medicago × trautvetteri var. subdicycla
intro: Medicago × trautvetteri var. subdicycla, commonly known as a type of alfalfa or lucerne, is a hybrid legume species. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Medicago × trautvetteri var. subdicycla are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
